      "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fuzz_parse.c",
      "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/build.sh",
      "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpac/src/filters/reframe_latm.c",

      "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpac/src/media_tools/av_parsers.c"

    "Key functions": [
      "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput (fuzz_parse.c): writes input to /tmp/libfuzzer.PID, calls gf_isom_open_file with GF_ISOM_OPEN_READ_DUMP",
      "latm_dmx_sync_frame_bs (reframe_latm.c): parses LATM sync frame, reads size bytes into buffer",
      "latm_dmx_check_dur (reframe_latm.c): accesses GF_M4ASampleRates[acfg.base_sr_index] and GF_M4ASampleRates[sr_idx]",
      "latm_dmx_check_pid (reframe_latm.c): contains fix check for GF_M4ASampleRates[base_sr_index]==0",
      "latm_dmx_process (reframe_latm.c): uses 4096-byte stack buffer latm_buffer, calls latm_dmx_sync_frame_bs",
      "gf_m4a_parse_config (av_parsers.c): reads base_sr_index as 4-bit value"
    ],
    "Data structures": {
      "GF_M4ASampleRates[]": "static const u32[16] in avparse.h",
      "GF_LATMDmxCtx": "contains acfg (GF_M4ADecSpecInfo), sr_idx, in_error (added by fix)"
    }
  },
  "TESTS": {
    "No local tests run yet",

  },
